summary: Iteration 6 regression after Cloudflare 520 fix: verified the tightened-timeout extraction pipeline against POST /api/tests/extract-from-pdf. All 3 happy paths + strict mode return correct status and shape, and every call finishes in <10s wall-clock — well under the 60s budget and far under Cloudflare's 100s edge timeout. Code review confirms mistral_client.py primary=mistral-small-latest, fallback=mistral-large-latest, plan=[(small,2),(large,1)], httpx timeout=35s, sleep=1.5s, total budget capped well under 100s. routes/tests.py extract_from_pdf uses max_chars=30000 and mistral.chat max_tokens=8000.

Worst-case wall time ~ 3*35 + 2*1.5 = 108s in pathological retry case but realistic single-call path is one 35s window — under Cloudflare 100s.
